summary: Checked all 33 estimates against the complete markdown conversion, including both appendices, and the PDF. Extracted every cited source page with PyMuPDF; inspected the outcome plots and randomization diagrams in memory and recovered the appendix tables. All 14 recorded pairwise p-values and the RAT Guidance-versus-None mean difference of -10.6 with 95% confidence limits -18.6 and -2.7 match the printed outcomes, phases and arms. The recruited/randomized study totals of 460 and 640 are supported; analysis-specific and arm-specific participant counts are not printed and correctly remain null. No numerical arm means, SDs or SEs can be transcribed from the unlabeled plots. Question, construct, measure, direction, AI availability, timing, comparison and design coding are consistent with the paper and codebook. Unspecified analysis units and uncertainty bases, the answer-key scoring convention, and the creative-flexibility similarity/dissimilarity inconsistency are already documented in the extraction. All 11 eligible outcome-by-phase groups have their three arm contrasts represented. No missing in-scope outcome or contrast and no confirmed extraction error were found.
